name: Minds 6: hoarders alive against the winter's severity
description: The number of hoarders alive at the end of the first winter (hoarder_alive; window_mean, ticks 190–200) in theft-winter-half's world (half the agents cheat; each cache found with chance 0.25; γ = 100) against the winter's severity β (seasons.winter_divisor): 2, 4, 8, 16 or 32, the divisor the summer's growth back-rate is cut by in winter. The sweep format takes one metric and no ratio, so it reports the hoarders' head count; the cheater advantage (per-capita hoarder and cheater survival) comes from the survey. Seeds 1–20.
